examples.arabic: اجاب الشرطي مساء النور انا بخير ما اسمك
examples.english: The policeman answered good evening I am fine what is your name.
examples.transliteration: ajaba ash shurti masa an nur ana bi khayr ma ismuka

examples.arabic: قال انا الان شرطي في المدينة
examples.english: He said, "I am now a policeman in the city."
examples.transliteration: Qāla anā al-āna shurṭiyyun fī al-madīnati.
